mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing temperatures of 41 degrees under clear skies at Fireman's Park with a waxing gibbous moon visible overhead.

The City of Verona is moving forward with an expansion of the Public Works and Utilities facility, which has outgrown its current capacity, alongside ongoing infrastructure improvements like the Mark Drive reconstruction project.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and more music tomorrow at Paddy Mac's, plus yoga sessions starting November 23.
Looking at the weekly report, on November 6, officers responded to a business on West Verona Avenue where they found a driver who was later arrested for O W I.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Really Reese's, and you can grab it when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
